cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je naučit posluchače znát principy práce nářadí a strojů sloužících k provádění pěstitelských operací v zahradnictví. Výuka je vedena tak, aby posluchač byl schopen na základě agrotechnických požadavků zvolit vhodný mechanizační prostředek pro konkrétní operaci a uměl zajistit jeho efektivní využití.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim is to teach students to know the principles of working equipment and machinery used for the production operations in horticulture. Teaching is conducted so that the listener was able to agro-technical requirements based on an appropriate means of mechanization for the specific operation and be able to ensure the effective use of.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to the course (allowance 2/2) a.The basic parameters of mechanizationb.Method of propulsion machinery, functional parts2.Energy sources (allowance 2/2) a.The main structural elements of tractors and tractorsb.One-axle small tractors, small tractors, special tractors3.Mechanization of soil treatment and pre-sowing soil preparation (allowance 2/2) a.Importance and methods of soil tillage, soil compactionb.Mouldboard plows, rotary, spade plowsc.Skids, rollers, cultivators, combinators4.Mechanization of fertilization (allowance 2/2) a.Organic fertilizer spreadersb.Mineral fertilizers spreaders5.Mechanization of sowing and planting (allowance 2/2) a.Sowing apparatusb.Sowing system for precision sowingc.Planters semiautomatic and automaticd.Machine tools for transplanting mature trees6.Mechanization of cultivation of crops (allowance 2/2) a.Mechanization for surface cultivationb.Mechanization alleyway of permanent crops7.Mechanization of chemical plant protection (allowance 2/2) a.Methods of chemical plant protectionb.Spraying, herbicide applicators8.Machines for the establishing and maintenance of lawns (allowance 2/2) a.Machinery for soil preparation and sowingb.Mowers9.Mechanization for harvesting vegetables (allowance 4/4) a.Mechanization for harvest the root, onion, brassicaceae, leafy and fruiting vegetables10.Mechanization for harvesting fruit (allowance 4/4) a.Mechanization for pome fruit harvestb.Mechanization harvesting stone fruit11.Mechanization for harvesting small fruits and grapes (allowance 2/2) a.Tools for semi-mechanized harvestingb.Mechanization of fully mechanized harvesting12.Mechanization used in closed areas (allowance 2/2) a.Handling and transport equipment in greenhouses

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: 100% presence on lessons. Submission of a seminar work during the semester The course is finished with credit test (maximum points for test 20, for credit is necessary to have min. 16 points). Final examination (1 hour, written part -- 60 % of the total mark, oral part 40 % of the total mark)
